about.label: OUR STORY
about.title: THE LCC
about.description: Founded in 2017, LCC has shaped the future of Lebanese cycling. Our culture of discipline, training, and commitment has produced multiple national champions and a strong roster of elite athletes.
about.descriptionLong: From mountain trails to coastal roads, our members push boundaries and challenge limits every day. With multiple Lebanese Championship titles and Lebanon Cup victories, we continue to inspire the next generation of cyclists in Lebanon and beyond.

contactPage.riderFAQ1Q: What are the requirements to join LCC?
contactPage.riderFAQ1A: We welcome cyclists of all levels. You should have a passion for cycling, a commitment to training, and the desire to be part of a competitive team.
contactPage.riderFAQ2Q: Do you have youth development programs?
contactPage.riderFAQ2A: Yes! We have comprehensive youth development programs for junior cyclists. Contact us for more information.
contactPage.riderFAQ3Q: What does the training schedule look like?
contactPage.riderFAQ3A: Training schedules vary by category and level. Our coaching staff will work with you to develop a personalized training plan.
contactPage.sponsorFAQ1A: We offer multiple partnership tiers including title sponsorship, official partnerships, and supporting partnerships.
contactPage.sponsorFAQ2Q: How can sponsoring LCC benefit my brand?
contactPage.sponsorFAQ2A: Sponsoring LCC connects your brand with passionate cycling enthusiasts and positions you as a supporter of sporting excellence in Lebanon.

anniversary.subtitle: 10 YEARS OF EXCELLENCE
anniversary.title: A Decade of Champions
anniversary.description: Since 2017, the Lebanese Cycling Club has been at the forefront of competitive cycling in Lebanon. We have built a legacy of championship victories, elite athletes, and an unwavering commitment to pushing the boundaries of what is possible on two wheels. From national championships to international recognition, our riders have proven that Lebanese cycling is a force to be reckoned with.
anniversary.closing: Thank you for being part of our first 10 years — the best is yet to come.
